# Southcoates Car Sales

> Southcoates Car Sales is an independent used car dealer in Hull, East Yorkshire. We began as a service and MOT centre serving the city for over 20 years and have been selling used cars for just over five. We offer finance from 10.4% APR (representative 19.9% APR), welcome part exchange, and include a minimum 3-month warranty with every car.

Based at 141 Southcoates Avenue, Hull, HU9 3HF, we offer finance (credit broker, not a lender), part exchange, a minimum 3-month warranty with extended 6 and 12 month options, and 3 years free servicing and MOT tests (subject to East Hull MOT and Repair Centre Limited).
